hotel: Kasteel Gemert Eindhoven, Curio Collection by Hilton
coverTag: A concept for a fourteenth-century castle entering a new chapter: Dutch heritage, light and time itself, expressed in a contemporary hand.
headline: Seven centuries of history deserve a collection that adds a new chapter, not a costume.
opportunity: Kasteel Gemert is being transformed with rare care: a fourteenth-century castle, a design-led renovation by Studio Piet Boon and the Netherlands' first Curio Collection by Hilton. A collection here should honour the depth of the place without imitating the past. We propose Dutch light, heritage colour and time itself, expressed in a contemporary hand.

reading.title: Heritage, not historicism

concept.title: The Light of Seven Centuries
concept.subtitle: Dutch heritage in a contemporary hand
concept.statement: The collection follows the castle's own timeline: from the deep, candlelit tones of its oldest halls to the clear light of the Golden Age and the calm of the new spa. Each work draws on Dutch visual heritage, from windmills and Delft blue to the tulip, and translates it into a contemporary, quietly luxurious language that rewards a second look.

pillars.title: Time as a theme
pillars.text: A signature work about time and light for the great hall: a fitting centrepiece for a castle that has seen seven centuries.

pillars.title: Brabant & the Low Countries
pillars.text: Landscape and heritage subjects that connect the castle to its region and to Dutch art history.

pillars.title: Calm for the spa
pillars.text: Soft cobalt fields for the spa and pool, chosen for stillness rather than spectacle.

collection.text: A champagne-gold hourglass of light: a meditation on time for a house with seven centuries of history.
The Dutch landscape at its most poetic, in warm dusk tones.
A calm field of cobalt for spaces made for rest.
A Delft-inspired pattern for suites, textiles or stationery.

bespoke.title: The Castle Portrait
bespoke.text: A signature portrait of Kasteel Gemert itself in Gallery Dutch Art's palette, for reception or the main stair.

bespoke.title: The Brabant Series
bespoke.text: A room series of numbered originals inspired by the landscape, crafts and heritage of the region.

email.subject: The Light of Seven Centuries: an art concept for Kasteel Gemert
body: Congratulations on the transformation of Kasteel Gemert into the Netherlands' first Curio Collection by Hilton.

I'm Mariska Beenen of Gallery Dutch Art, an Amsterdam studio creating bespoke art and collections for hospitality. Inspired by the castle's history and its new chapter, we prepared a short concept, "The Light of Seven Centuries": a signature work about time and light for the great hall, a portrait of the castle itself and a room series inspired by Brabant, all in a contemporary hand that sits quietly within a refined interior.
Would you be open to a twenty-minute conversation in the coming weeks?

Warm regards,
Mariska Beenen
Gallery Dutch Art · Amsterdam
